To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a systematic bias exists in the quoting patterns of different media outlets; (2) this systematic bias is reflected in the linguistic content of quotes selected by the outlets; and (3) the systematic bias aligns well with the political ideology and outlet's type, with the different types of outlets portraying different realities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structure of political discourse, and how it relates to media outlets and their ideological leanings.
quantifying, characterizing and analyzing the structure of political bias in news media.
the structure of political coverage in the media, and how it is shaped by systematic quoting patterns.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the structure of the political media landscape is characterized by the presence of a low-rank latent bias space, which is aligned with political ideology and media type, and is manifested in the quoting patterns of media outlets.
the structure of political news is indeed biased, and that this bias is systematic and predictable, but that this bias is not uniform across outlets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a framework for measuring bias in the media based on the quoting patterns of news outlets, and have used this framework to reveal a latent space of media bias.
the structure of political bias in the media can be captured by a low dimensional space that is aligned with political ideology and media type.
the media outlets' quoting behavior is systematic, predictable, and exhibits a latent structure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a systematic bias does indeed exist and can be quantified, characterized and exploited in the context of news media outlets.
the structure of political news is more systematic than previously thought, and that it can be quantitatively and empirically characterized.
media outlets do not simply report the news, but actively shape it by selecting which quotes to include.
